work.heading: DEXXON
work.subtitle: Internship Developer
work.description: This project aims to develop an efficient software system to support software engineers in managing industrial equipment data, focusing on tracking and evaluating the service life of pipe systems such as pipelines and piping systems within industry. The system enables users to record and manage equipment data through a centralized digital platform, serving as a centralized data management hub to increase accuracy and data accessibility. Additionally, the system processes data to calculate critical parameters related to equipment lifespan, operating conditions, and degradation factors, supporting systematic and reliable equipment condition assessment for practical use, clear data analysis, and effective decision-making for maintenance planning and industrial equipment management.
